visualCharacteristics.notes: Full-width 16x9 cross-fading hero slides with stacked uppercase headline (+ light tagline), slide count, caption + EXPLORE button, prev/next arrow buttons.

contentPattern.structure: per slide: image | heading (h2) + optional tagline paragraph + body paragraph + CTA link (with 2+ plain paragraphs the first is the tagline)

suitableFor: full-width feature/powertrain sliders with arrow navigation
image slides with headline, copy and single CTA
notSuitableFor: sliders needing image thumbnail navigation (use carousel-thumbnails)
card sliders showing several items at once (use carousel-cards)
